column1: # Remote ATV 6.1.0 build 45; optional D-pad hold tolerance after swipe lock.
# Removes post-accept movement cancellation only after a hold/repeat has started,
# in both repeat modes, for Gy buttons whose callback is one of the ancestor Px D-pad arrows.
# Center/select, other controls, pre-accept tolerance and cancellation paths stay intact.
# No allocation/call in the hook; resume the original getter before its allocation.
